policy: A plugin is integrated only after a real passing remote run and protected publication are evidenced.
onboarding_requirements: Observed repository and owner, no inferred URL
Version/header/readme agreement and GPL-compatible dependency inventory
Lint, security regressions, actual WordPress runtime and Plugin Check
Exact artifact checksum, commit and CI run provenance
Protected PR/main/tags and explicit release approval
Validated mirror, rollback rehearsal and alert receipt
